project1.title: GlobalEmploi
project1.description: A remote-job aggregator built for Algerian candidates — pulling live listings from a curated pipeline of international sources into a single, fast, filterable frontend. Led the interface end-to-end with occasional backend contributions to the aggregation layer.

project2.title: Orkestra
project2.description: A BFSI analytics cockpit built for Malyz Consulting (Geneva) to serve Swiss SMEs. Led the entire front-end, wired to Helvebroker SA and Odoo backends, with a Mistral AI agent for on-demand financial reasoning.

project3.title: Docpilote
project3.description: Medical-practice management SaaS for Algerian clinics — patients, appointments, prescriptions and billing in DA. Full Arabic / French RTL interface, offline support for spotty networks, and workflows shaped around real clinical routines.

project4.title: Headless E-commerce Platform
project4.description: Built entirely solo for the Algerian market. A Dockerized WordPress + WooCommerce backend exposes a custom 125-route REST API (RBAC, audit trail, cash-on-delivery, Yalidine + ZR Express shipping adapters, Chargily payments, CMS, analytics) — consumed by two decoupled Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript frontends. Bilingual FR / AR with full RTL, mobile-first, ships a staff admin panel and a customer storefront.

project5.title: Esprit Livre
project5.description: A full-featured book e-commerce platform with a dedicated User app for browsing and purchasing, and a powerful Admin app giving the store owner complete control over products, orders, and content. The project emphasizes usability, motion-driven feedback, and scalable UI architecture.

project6.title: Hotel Booking Platform
project6.description: A full Next.js hotel website with room booking, restaurant, events, and an integrated AI concierge. Ships with a lightweight admin dashboard at /admin for content and inventory.

project7.title: Doctoque
project7.description: Contributed to Doctoque — a production SaaS platform for law firms on a Next.js + Odoo stack. Refined UI/UX flows, cleaned the codebase, and shipped measurable web-performance improvements.

project8.title: AcademAI
project8.description: An intelligent platform empowering medical students and professors with AI-driven diagnostics, adaptive quizzes, and automated course corrections — paired with a powerful admin dashboard for content oversight.

intro.title: AcademAI
intro.description: An AI-powered medical education platform designed to support students through intelligent diagnostics, adaptive learning, and course correction.

adminIntro.title: Admin Dashboard
adminIntro.description: Comprehensive admin platform for managing medical education content, monitoring student progress, and overseeing course corrections.

feature01.label: Feature 01
feature01.title: AI Diagnostic Chat
feature01.description: Natural language processing enables students to ask medical questions and receive instant, accurate diagnostic guidance with cited medical sources.

feature02.label: Feature 02
feature02.title: Adaptive Quiz System
feature02.description: AI-generated quizzes adapt to student performance and learning patterns. Questions reinforce weak areas and build comprehensive medical knowledge.

feature03.label: Feature 03
feature03.title: PDF Course Correction
feature03.description: Upload medical textbooks or study materials to receive AI-powered corrections and annotations. The system identifies outdated information and provides current medical guidelines.

feature04.label: Feature 04
feature04.title: Profile & Access
feature04.description: Personalized student profiles with subscription management and premium features tailored for medical education.

feature05.label: Design System
feature05.title: Light & Dark Mode
feature05.description: A carefully designed theme system optimized for extended study sessions. Dark mode reduces eye strain during night studying, while light mode ensures clarity in clinical settings.

adminFeature01.label: Feature 01
adminFeature01.title: Admin Dashboard
adminFeature01.description: Centralized command center with real-time analytics, student activity monitoring, and platform health metrics.

adminFeature02.label: Feature 02
adminFeature02.title: User Management
adminFeature02.description: Complete oversight of student and educator accounts. View detailed user profiles, edit permissions, and monitor individual learning progress.

adminFeature03.label: Feature 03
adminFeature03.title: Quiz Analytics
adminFeature03.description: Deep insights into student performance and quiz effectiveness. Track completion rates, difficulty patterns, and learning outcomes.

adminFeature04.label: Feature 04
adminFeature04.title: Course Correction Review
adminFeature04.description: Review, approve, and manage AI-generated course corrections. Examine detailed correction reports and validate suggested updates.

adminFeature05.label: Feature 05
adminFeature05.title: Payment Management
adminFeature05.description: Monitor subscription revenue, track transactions, and manage payment operations with detailed financial reporting.

adminFeature06.label: Feature 06
adminFeature06.title: Settings & Security
adminFeature06.description: Platform configuration and security controls. Manage system settings, configure AI parameters, and maintain security.

about.title: About

about.paragraph1: I design in Figma, build with Next.js + TypeScript, style with Tailwind, and bring interfaces to life using Framer Motion — delivering production-ready products that perform flawlessly.
about.paragraph2: Final-year Computer Science student actively freelancing and shipping personal projects reaching thousands of users.
